note: Below Tuttle Creek dam on the west shore of River Pond, the dam's outlet lake: the River Pond loops (full-hookup and water/electric pull-throughs on asphalt, a row of short 30 A back-ins along the south road, primitive shore sites, cabins) and the Riley Point peninsula loop at the south end, whose six prime sites sit nearest the water. Swim beach and showers nearby. --Claude
summary: campitks per-site read: River Pond 89 RV sites (8 FHU 50 A, 76 W/E, 5 primitive) + Riley Point 36 (26 W/E, 10 primitive) = 125, max 80 ft, 56 pull-throughs; open year round; self-reg allowed. Fees gain the full-hookup surcharge. Waterfront pond -> lakeview proposed. Riley Point is contiguous, not a split.
flags: WATERFRONT (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 'pond' -> propose LAKEVIEW. The campground is below Tuttle Creek dam (dam embankment ~0.7-1 km NW of the sites), so it has no Tuttle Creek Lake value; it sits on River Pond, the outlet lake, which imagery shows at roughly 1 km x 0.6 km of open water plus bays (tens of hectares, far over the ~5-acre pond line), so 'pond' is the wrong class. Per site: campitks tags 'Proximity to Water: Y' only on Riley Point 092-095, 097, 101 and primitive 955-959 / 960-965; the main River Pond rows are 'Within 1/8 Mile' (sites 001-070 sit ~60-200 m back, behind the loop road and day-use lawns) and 711-912 are 'Across Road'. On the 300 m frame, Riley 101 is ~20 m from the shore but behind a shoreline tree fringe, and 094/095 are ~30-45 m from the point, whose open sandy tip looks like the day-use/beach area; 960-965 sit on the shore road. An unused open apron to the water is not clearly shown at any RV site, so lakefront is not earned: went down. If AWH knows Riley 094/095/101 have open bank to the water, those would be lakefront.

SPLIT: Riley Point is NOT a split candidate. It is the south tip of the same peninsula, below the dam on River Pond (not on the lake above the dam), and runs straight on from the River Pond loop's 711-912 row along the same road (site 912 to site 104 ~ 30 m). River Pond loop centroid 39.25228,-96.58962; Riley Point centroid 39.24662,-96.58772 (~650 m apart, no separate entrance seen). Riley Point per-area, for the record: 26 water/electric (079-084 30/20 A 70 ft back-in; 085-104 50/30/20 A 40-65 ft, 101 the only pull-through), 10 primitive 950-959 (60 ft, 950-954 pull-through), showers within 1/4 mile, 6 prime shore sites.

OTHER TUTTLE CREEK SP AREAS: Rocky Ford is 2116 (verified p3-303); Fancy Creek is 13952; Cedar Ridge (a primitive area on the lake above the dam, ~2.5 km N; the KDWP "Spillway" area name could not be matched to a campitks loop because ksoutdoors.gov is unreadable) is 13953. campitks also lists Fancy Creek Hidden Hollow and Fancy Creek Lake View loops (not read; presumably inside 13952) and N Randolph (2 shelters only, not a lead).

ADD LEAD: Tuttle Creek SP South Randolph loop (campitks loop 510335) is not in the DB: 20 'Standard with Electric Hookup' sites, 50/30/20 A, no water hookups (4 tagged sewer), 17 back-in + 3 pull-through, max length 50 ft on 12 sites (one site 20 ft), showers 'Within 1/4 Mile' on all 20, 'Proximity to Water: None'. Site centroid 39.42766,-96.71141, ~2.6 km SE of 13952 Fancy Creek's pin (39.4437,-96.7336) off Hwy 16 near Randolph. 13952's note counts '24 electric-only sites', which may or may not include these - check before adding.
PIN 39.2522,-96.5895 is at the River Pond loop's site centroid (39.25228,-96.58962); OK.
